# Clean Air Fund

> > A global philanthropic foundation dedicated to tackling air pollution through grants, research, and advocacy across health, climate, and social equity dimensions.

Clean Air Fund is a philanthropic organization working to address the global air pollution crisis, which causes millions of deaths annually and disproportionately affects vulnerable populations. The foundation operates through grants programs, direct projects, and data initiatives across multiple regions including India, Indonesia, Ghana, and the European Union.

## Key Topics

- Air pollution
- PM2.5 (particulate matter)
- Health impacts
- Environmental justice
- Air quality data
- Vulnerable populations
- Urban air quality
- Emissions reduction
- Low emission zones
- Climate action
- Public health
- Grants program
- WHO (World Health Organization)
- C40 Cities
- State of Global Air

- [Grants - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/what-we-do/our-grants): Grants program supporting NGOs, charities and researchers fighting pollution

- [Take action - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/why-clean-air/take-action): Practical steps for policymakers, businesses and citizens to tackle pollution

- [Health and air pollution - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/theme/health): Health impacts of air pollution and public health emergency overview

## Climate, Economics & Equity

- [Climate and air pollution - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/theme/climate): Connection between air pollution and climate change via fossil fuels
- [Economy and air pollution - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/theme/economics): Economic impacts of air pollution on healthcare costs and productivity
- [Society and air pollution - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/theme/inequality): Air pollution inequality affecting disadvantaged communities globally

## Urban Solutions & Data

- [Cities and air pollution - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/theme/cities): Urban air pollution hotspots and sustainable transportation solutions
- [Data - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/theme/data): Air quality data platforms including Breathe London and Open AQ

- [Ghana - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/geography/ghana): Clean Air Fund work in Ghana: 28,000 annual deaths from air pollution
- [European Union - Clean Air Fund](https://www.cleanairfund.org/geography/europe): Clean Air Fund work in EU: Poland and Bulgaria air pollution initiatives
